chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār narrated from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say regarding the qunut of Jumuʿah: if he is an Imam, he performs qunut in the first rakʿah; and if he is praying four rakʿahs, then in the second rakʿah before the rukuʿ.

key_terms.أَرْبَعًا: four rakʿahs, referring to the alternative prayer form

ai.seo_question: When is the qunut performed in Salat al-Jumuʿah according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the ruling of qunut in the Friday prayer. It distinguishes between one leading as Imam in Salat al-Jumuʿah and one praying four rakʿahs, specifying where the qunut is to be performed in each case.
